title: Getting Bob Lazar onto Joe Rogan's show by speakerphone call during a Michigan screening trip

tellings.quote: Bob said I go, "Bob, look, George and I are coming out because we have a a premiere or a screening um in Michigan.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that around 2019 he helped get Bob Lazar, a man who says he once worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada, onto the show of Joe Rogan, a hugely popular podcast host. Corbell says it started with a speakerphone call, when he told Lazar that he and his colleague George Knapp were coming out for a film screening in Michigan. He tells it as the inside story of how Lazar's account reached a huge new audience.
